name: pinboard
description: Pinned notes above the prompt: /pin a note (! important, !! interrupt Claude), check it off or remove it with ×; each new pin reaches Claude at once; kept per folder; what you type is listed for the session

deliver.title: Send new pins to Claude
deliver.description: Each new pin is added to the conversation at once, so Claude reads it at its next step even in the middle of a turn

capture.title: List what you type
capture.description: Prompts you send, idle or while Claude is working, are listed on the board, dimmed, for this session only (not saved)

showBoard.title: Show the board at start
showBoard.description: When off (the default), each session starts with the board folded to its header line; unfold it with [Show] or /pin
